description:
`results-data/corpus-inventory.json` is currently maintained by hand. It
enumerates every bundle in the seed corpus with metadata (benchmark,
platform, scale, trust label, hash). Once Phase 2 community PRs start
landing, hand-maintenance will drift: contributors will forget to update
the inventory, maintainers will forget to nudge them, and the explorer
static-build pipeline will silently see a stale view of the corpus.

This item replaces the hand-maintained file with a generated one. The
generator scans `results-data/bundles/` recursively, extracts metadata
from each bundle's schema-v2 header (and sidecar manifest where present),
and writes a deterministic, sorted `corpus-inventory.json`. A pre-commit
hook and a CI step prevent drift.

anti_patterns.why: PRs need to fail loudly with "run the script" guidance, not silently regenerate and hide drift.
timestamp drift would defeat the purpose; the deterministic comparison must be byte-stable.

anti_patterns.dont: parse the submission-manifest.json contents for trust resolution

preserves.behavior: Existing fields/shape consumed by any downstream tool referencing `corpus-inventory.json`. Audit consumers in w5 before changing the shape.
Existing pipeline at `benchbox/core/explorer_pipeline/` - it builds its own manifest; the inventory is a separate, lighter index.
The schema-v2 bundle format and the trust-label sidecar contract - generator reads, never mutates.

verifications.command: uv run -- python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --write && uv run -- python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --check
verifications.description: Generator runs cleanly against current corpus, --check passes after --write

verifications.command: uv run -- python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --write && cp results-data/corpus-inventory.json /tmp/inv1.json && uv run -- python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --write && diff /tmp/inv1.json results-data/corpus-inventory.json
verifications.description: Generated file is byte-identical when run twice (deterministic)
verifications.expected: no diff (modulo generated_at if not stripped)

work_units.notes:
Inputs: scan `results-data/bundles/` for `*.json` (excluding sidecar
files matching `submission-manifest.json` and any `.plans.json` /
`.tuning.json` companions).

For each bundle:
  - Parse schema-v2 header: benchmark, platform, scale_factor,
    timestamp, query_count, query_set
  - Detect sibling `submission-manifest.json` → trust_label =
    community-submission, else default maintainer-run
  - Compute SHA256 of the bundle file
  - Capture relative path

Output: `results-data/corpus-inventory.json` with
  - `generated_at` (UTC ISO timestamp, omit if --check)
  - `bundles[]` sorted by (benchmark, platform, scale_factor, timestamp)
  - `cohorts` summary: per-(benchmark, scale) lists of platforms
  - `summary`: total_bundles, by_benchmark, by_platform, by_trust_label

Flags:
  - `--check` → exit 1 if generated content differs from on-disk file
    (no write, deterministic - no `generated_at`)
  - `--write` → overwrite `corpus-inventory.json`
Default: `--write`.

`tests/unit/scripts/test_generate_corpus_inventory.py`:
  - Empty bundles dir → empty inventory with consistent shape
  - Single bundle without sidecar → maintainer-run trust label
  - Single bundle with sidecar → community-submission
  - Multiple bundles → sorted deterministically
  - Cohort summary: 3 platforms at same (benchmark, scale) groups
    correctly
  - Hash matches sha256 of bundle file
  - `--check` returns 0 on match, 1 on drift, prints diff
  - Companion files (.plans.json, .tuning.json) excluded from bundle
    enumeration
  - Malformed bundle JSON → fail with clear message naming the file
work_units.summary: Add unit tests for the generator

work_units.notes:
Update `.github/workflows/validate-submission.yml` to add a step after
bundle validation:
  `uv run python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --check`
A failing check posts a PR comment instructing the contributor to run
`uv run python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --write` locally
and amend the PR. Keep the message friendly - most contributors will
not have read the contributor guide before this point.
work_units.summary: Wire the generator into validate-submission CI workflow

work_units.notes:
Add to `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (or create one if absent):
  - id: corpus-inventory
    name: corpus-inventory drift check
    entry: uv run python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --check
    files: ^results-data/bundles/
    language: system
    pass_filenames: false
Document hook installation in `docs/contributing-results.md`.
work_units.summary: Add pre-commit hook entry for the generator

work_units.notes:
1. Run `--write` against the current corpus.
2. Diff against the existing hand-maintained file. Any diff is suspect:
   investigate whether the hand-maintained file is right (then fix the
   generator) or the generator is right (then commit the regenerated
   file with a chore commit).
3. The pipeline at `benchbox/core/explorer_pipeline/` already derives
   its own manifest, so confirm no consumer depends on the
   hand-curated shape.

Update `docs/contributing-results.md`:
  - Replace any "edit corpus-inventory.json" instruction with
    "run `uv run python scripts/generate_corpus_inventory.py --write`".
  - Note that CI will reject PRs whose inventory drifts.
Add a one-liner to the Phase 2 ops runbook (TODO
`write-results-platform-phase-2-operations-runbook`) referencing the
same.
work_units.summary: Document the generator in contributor guide and ops runbook
